description: Maryland Temporary Cash Assistance is the state’s TANF cash program for eligible families with dependent children. Assistance comes with family and work-program obligations.
introduction: Maryland Temporary Cash Assistance is the state’s TANF cash program for eligible families with dependent children. Assistance comes with family and work-program obligations.

who: Families must meet financial and technical rules; income is evaluated against the assistance-unit benefit level.
Child-support cooperation, work activities and substance-abuse provisions apply. Explain barriers and ask the worker about applicable exceptions or accommodations.
sections.get: Approved TCA provides cash assistance while the family works toward independence. Families can also ask about a separate application for child care costs.
sections.docs: Prepare child and household information, income records and any child-support documents. Ask the local department for a case-specific checklist and explain any difficulty obtaining proof.
sections.apply:
1. Apply at Maryland Benefits or contact the local Department of Social Services.
  2. Paper applications can be delivered, mailed or faxed through the local office’s instructions.
  3. Provide verification and discuss work and child-support requirements with the worker.
sections.after: Read the decision and participation requirements. Report changes and keep appointment records. If a requirement is difficult to meet, tell the worker before missing it; noncompliance can affect benefits.

faqs: Does SNAP automatically enroll me in TCA?
No. Make sure the cash program is requested and provide the additional family information.
Can someone deliver a paper application for me?
The state permits someone else to drop it off. Follow the local office’s submission instructions.
Can I also ask about child care?
Yes. Maryland says families can file an application for child care assistance.
What if I cannot meet a work activity?
Contact your worker promptly to explain the barrier and ask about an exception, accommodation or support.

provenance.review_scope: Program purpose, eligibility pathway and application methods; no unverified dollar limits published.
